briefs.speaker: Dan Crenshaw
briefs.speaker_context: U.S. Congressman (Texas Republican), House committees on foreign affairs/intelligence matters
briefs.current_title: 克伦肖议员：中期选举后，白宫会接受结果吗？

subtitles.zh: 您如何看待这次中期选举？您的国会任期将在几个月后结束。
subtitles.en: How are you thinking about these midterms? Your tenure in the Congress will end here in a few months time.

subtitles.zh: 我们正在关注德州的参议院选情。请问您打算在几周后的参议院选举中投票给肯·帕克斯顿吗？
subtitles.en: We're watching this Senate race unfold in Texas. May I ask if you intend to vote for Ken Paxton in that Senate race in a couple weeks?

subtitles.zh: 是的，是的。我的意思是，看，肯·帕克斯顿，我个人从未对他有意见。
subtitles.en: Yeah, yeah. I mean, look, Ken Paxton, I've never had a problem personally with Ken Paxton.

subtitles.zh: 约翰·科宁绝对会是更好的选择，但詹姆斯·希拉里则是更糟糕的选择。
subtitles.en: John Corning absolutely would have been a better choice, but James Hillary goes a much worse choice.

subtitles.zh: 不幸的是，这就是如今投票的现状。
subtitles.en: And unfortunately, like, that's what, that's what voting is these days.

subtitles.zh: 肯·帕克斯顿会投票支持我会支持的事情。所以，我当然会投给他，
subtitles.en: Ken Paxton's going to vote for the things that I would vote for. So, of course, I'll vote for him,

subtitles.zh: 但我也要完全诚实地说，约翰·科宁，如果约翰·科宁是我们的提名人，我们这里根本不会有竞争。
subtitles.en: but I'm also going to be completely honest and admit that John Corning, we wouldn't even have a race here if John Corning was our nominee.

subtitles.zh: 不会有，没人会关注德州，因为他会轻松获胜。
subtitles.en: There wouldn't be, nobody would be paying attention to Texas because he would win easily.

subtitles.zh: 您是否担心，如果共和党在中期选举中大败，白宫将不接受这一结果，并继续削弱人们对选举的信心？
subtitles.en: Are you concerned at all that if Republicans lose large in the midterms that that result will not be accepted by the White House and that it will continue to degrade faith in the election?

subtitles.zh: 如果共和党大败，您预计白宫或总统会有某种反弹吗？
subtitles.en: Are you expecting some sort of pushback if Republicans lose big from the White House from the president?

subtitles.zh: 我没有看到任何迹象。显然，阿拉斯加有一个案例，看起来，我的意思是，民主党在阿拉斯加的做法很糟糕。
subtitles.en: I've seen no indication of that. Obviously, there's that one case in Alaska where it looks like, I mean, what Democrats did in Alaska was messed up.

subtitles.zh: 他们在选票上放了另一个人，与现任参议员丹·沙利文同名。
subtitles.en: They put another guy on the ballot with the same name as the sitting Senator Dan Sullivan.

subtitles.zh: 这显然是为了迷惑选民。司法部正当地试图对此进行抗争。除此之外，我没有看到任何迹象。
subtitles.en: It was very obviously meant to confuse voters. DOJ rightfully is trying to fight that. Other than that, I don't see any signs of that.

subtitles.zh: 最后，我想接着您刚才提到的肯·帕克斯顿和约翰·科宁之间的对比。
subtitles.en: Let me end by just picking up on something you said a moment ago about that contrast between Ken Paxton and John Corning.

subtitles.zh: 我只是好奇，在您准备离开国会之际，您对我们政治状况的看法。
subtitles.en: And I'm just curious of your sense of the state of our politics as you're preparing to leave Congress.

subtitles.zh: 经历过这一切，您对2026年美国选举政治的状况有多大信心？
subtitles.en: Having been through it, what confidence, how do you feel about the state of American electoral politics in the year 2026?

subtitles.zh: 您有多少时间？也许我们做个一小时的采访。我们可以继续。先生，我们只有1分28秒。
subtitles.en: How long do you have? Maybe let's do an hour long interview. We can keep to die. We got one minute and 28 seconds, sir.

subtitles.zh: 好的。那么，在1分20秒内，我会告诉您，这与我2018年开始时非常不同。
subtitles.en: Okay. Well, in one minute and 20 seconds, I'll tell you that it's very different than since I started in 2018.

briefs.current_title: 克伦肖议员：中期选举后，白宫会接受结果吗？

subtitles.zh: 您如何看待这次中期选举？您的国会任期将在几个月后结束。
subtitles.en: How are you thinking about these midterms? Your tenure in the Congress will end here in a few months time.

subtitles.zh: 我们正在关注德州的参议院选情。请问您打算在几周后的参议院选举中投票给肯·帕克斯顿吗？
subtitles.en: We're watching this Senate race unfold in Texas. May I ask if you intend to vote for Ken Paxton in that Senate race in a couple weeks?

subtitles.zh: 是的，是的。我的意思是，看，肯·帕克斯顿，我个人从未对他有意见。
subtitles.en: Yeah, yeah. I mean, look, Ken Paxton, I've never had a problem personally with Ken Paxton.

subtitles.zh: 约翰·科宁绝对会是更好的选择，但詹姆斯·希拉里则是更糟糕的选择。
subtitles.en: John Corning absolutely would have been a better choice, but James Hillary goes a much worse choice.

subtitles.zh: 不幸的是，这就是如今投票的现状。
subtitles.en: And unfortunately, like, that's what, that's what voting is these days.

subtitles.zh: 肯·帕克斯顿会投票支持我会支持的事情。所以，我当然会投给他，
subtitles.en: Ken Paxton's going to vote for the things that I would vote for. So, of course, I'll vote for him,

subtitles.zh: 但我也要完全诚实地说，约翰·科宁，如果约翰·科宁是我们的提名人，我们这里根本不会有竞争。
subtitles.en: but I'm also going to be completely honest and admit that John Corning, we wouldn't even have a race here if John Corning was our nominee.

subtitles.zh: 不会有，没人会关注德州，因为他会轻松获胜。
subtitles.en: There wouldn't be, nobody would be paying attention to Texas because he would win easily.

subtitles.zh: 您是否担心，如果共和党在中期选举中大败，白宫将不接受这一结果，并继续削弱人们对选举的信心？
subtitles.en: Are you concerned at all that if Republicans lose large in the midterms that that result will not be accepted by the White House and that it will continue to degrade faith in the election?

subtitles.zh: 如果共和党大败，您预计白宫或总统会有某种反弹吗？
subtitles.en: Are you expecting some sort of pushback if Republicans lose big from the White House from the president?

subtitles.zh: 我没有看到任何迹象。显然，阿拉斯加有一个案例，看起来，我的意思是，民主党在阿拉斯加的做法很糟糕。
subtitles.en: I've seen no indication of that. Obviously, there's that one case in Alaska where it looks like, I mean, what Democrats did in Alaska was messed up.

subtitles.zh: 他们在选票上放了另一个人，与现任参议员丹·沙利文同名。
subtitles.en: They put another guy on the ballot with the same name as the sitting Senator Dan Sullivan.

subtitles.zh: 这显然是为了迷惑选民。司法部正当地试图对此进行抗争。除此之外，我没有看到任何迹象。
subtitles.en: It was very obviously meant to confuse voters. DOJ rightfully is trying to fight that. Other than that, I don't see any signs of that.

subtitles.zh: 最后，我想接着您刚才提到的肯·帕克斯顿和约翰·科宁之间的对比。
subtitles.en: Let me end by just picking up on something you said a moment ago about that contrast between Ken Paxton and John Corning.

subtitles.zh: 我只是好奇，在您准备离开国会之际，您对我们政治状况的看法。
subtitles.en: And I'm just curious of your sense of the state of our politics as you're preparing to leave Congress.
